verdict.rationale: Seeing, attributing, and alerting on observability spend is a fair axis for an observability vendor, but the pack contains no evidence that Datadog shows its own usage or bill, attributes it to teams or services, or alerts on usage spikes. The Cloud Cost Management entry (datadog-docs-15) is only a page title about cloud infrastructure cost, not observability spend. Generic Monitors docs (datadog-docs-10) are not shown to apply to usage or billing data. The only on-topic item is a customer report of 'lack of billing transparency' (datadog-comm-8), which argues against this capability rather than for it.
